question: The average age of 36 students of a class is 12 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 13 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Extra total = Increase in average × New total

⇒ Increase in average = 13 − 12 = 1

⇒ Extra total = 1 × 37 = 37

⇒ Teacher's age = 12 + 37 = 49

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 36 students = 12 years

Average age of group including teacher = 13 years

Number of students = 36, Total members = 37

**Formula used:**

Total age = Average × Number

Teacher's age = Total age with teacher − Total age of students

**Calculations:**

Total age of students = 12 × 36 = 432 years

⇒ Total age with teacher = 13 × 37 = 481 years

⇒ Teacher's age = 481 − 432 = 49 years

**∴ The correct answer is 49 years.**
